headline: Argus Partners acts on Indo-Japanese JV between Syrma SGS and Kaga Electronics India
sum: Syrma SGS Technology Limited has entered into a strategic joint venture with Kaga Electronics India Private Limited, the Indian subsidiary of Japan's Kaga Electronics Co. Ltd.
detail: Syrma SGS Technology Limited has entered into a strategic joint venture with Kaga Electronics India Private Limited, the Indian subsidiary of Japan's Kaga Electronics Co. Ltd. Argus Partners advised Syrma SGS on this joint venture. The transaction team consisted of Abhinav Bhalaik (Partner), Aayush Kumar (Partner) and Paridhi Rastogi (Associate).
